text_block_list.text: Нарита Брайан loses to Бива Хаяхидэ.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Бива Хаяхидэ calmly analyzes
the
situation. She reminds Нарита Брайан
that she only
lost because she's still in
her classic year and in
the process of
growing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She goes on to claim that the she won't
consider
herself as truly having won until
she wins again
next year. The two of
them promise each other a
rematch in a
senior race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
